definitions.explanation: The meat of sheep, as a category of food. A slightly technical or written word: menus and shops usually use ラム or マトン instead.

examples.japanese: {羊肉|ようにく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{羊肉|ようにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: People eat a lot of mutton in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われ→言う：00515_iu⟧、{羊肉|ようにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{消費量|しょうひりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Consumption of mutton has been rising lately, as it is said to be good for your health.

notes:
From ⟦{羊|ひつじ}→羊：04713_hitsuji⟧ (sheep) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat), following the same pattern as ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧ and ⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羊肉|ようにく}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: mutton dishes
- {羊肉|ようにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill mutton
- {羊肉|ようにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{臭|にお}い: the smell of mutton

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ラム: lamb — meat from a young sheep, milder; the usual word on menus
- マトン: mutton — meat from an adult sheep, stronger in flavor
- ⟦ジンギスカン→ジンギスカン：30439_jingisukan⟧: Genghis Khan — the Hokkaido dish of grilled mutton and vegetables
